html:
1What You Will Learn

Note

Acronyms in this note. CAF: Cloud Adoption Framework; IAM: Identity and Access Management; AI: artificial intelligence; WAF: Web Application Firewall; KMS: Key Management Service; ACM: AWS Certificate Manager; ACL: access control list; ECS: Elastic Container Service; EKS: Elastic Kubernetes Service; ECR: Elastic Container Registry; EBS: Elastic Block Store; EFS: Elastic File System; IA: Infrequent Access; AZ: Availability Zone; RDS: Relational Database Service; VPN: virtual private network; SQS: Simple Queue Service; SNS: Simple Notification Service; EMR: Elastic MapReduce; TAM: Technical Account Manager; MFA: multi-factor authentication; EC2: Elastic Compute Cloud

  • See the whole exam on one page: domains, weights and where each topic lives
  • Tell look-alike services apart in pairs and sets
  • Use a need-to-service chooser for the questions that describe a need
  • Recall the lists the exam likes, and the terms that trip people up

2A one-page review of the whole course

Running case

Tidewater's Final Review

  • Tidewater's shop now runs on AWS: accounts, security, servers, storage, databases, networks and costs
  • Before the exam, the founder wants one page per topic, not fourteen modules
  • The team keeps mixing up look-alike services
  • Your job: review quickly, and fix the confusions that cost points

The Exam on One Page

Domain and weight Modules Core ideas
Cloud Concepts (24%) 1 and 2 Six advantages, elasticity, high availability, cloud economics; six pillars, CAF, seven Rs
Security and Compliance (30%) 3 to 5 Shared responsibility, Artifact, encryption, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, Config, IAM, security services
Cloud Technology and Services (34%) 6 to 12 Access and global infrastructure, compute, storage, databases, networking, AI and analytics, other services
Billing, Pricing, and Support (12%) 13 and 14 Purchasing options, Organizations, cost tools, support plans, partners
  • 65 questions, 90 minutes, 700 to pass on a scale of 100 to 1,000
Exam tip

Domains 1 and 2 together are more than half of the exam; do not skip them.

Look-Alikes: Security and Identity

Look-alikes Tell them apart
GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie Threats in logs; vulnerabilities; sensitive data in S3
Detective, Security Hub Root cause of a finding; one view of findings and standards
WAF, Shield, Firewall Manager Web requests; DDoS; one policy for many accounts
KMS, CloudHSM, ACM Managed keys; dedicated hardware; certificates
User, group, role Long-term credentials; shared permissions; temporary credentials
Secrets Manager, Parameter Store Rotating secrets; plain settings
Identity Center, Cognito, Directory Service Workforce sign-in; app customers; Active Directory
CloudTrail, CloudWatch, Config Who did it; how healthy; what changed
Security group, network ACL Stateful per resource; stateless per subnet
Exam tip

Learn the one-line job of each; the exam describes the job, not the name.

Look-Alikes: Compute, Storage and Databases

Look-alikes Tell them apart
Load balancer, Auto Scaling Shares traffic; adds and removes servers
ECS, EKS, ECR AWS orchestration; Kubernetes; image library
Fargate, Lambda Containers with no servers; functions on events
EBS, instance store, EFS, FSx Persistent disk; temporary disk; shared Linux files; Windows shares
S3 Standard, IA, Glacier Frequent; infrequent; archive
Multi-AZ, read replica Failover; read scaling
RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache Managed relational; MySQL and PostgreSQL compatible; key-value; in-memory cache
Storage Gateway, Backup, Elastic Disaster Recovery On-premises access; policy-based copies; fast recovery
Exam tip

Ask: what is the data model, and how much do I want to manage?

Look-Alikes: Networking, Integration, AI and Analytics

Look-alikes Tell them apart
VPN, Direct Connect Encrypted over the internet; a dedicated line
Route 53, CloudFront, Global Accelerator DNS; cached content at the edge; static IPs and global routing
SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions Queue; fan-out; events and schedules; workflows
Comprehend, Textract, Transcribe, Polly Text insights; scanned forms; speech to text; text to speech
Rekognition, Lex, SageMaker AI Images; chatbots; your own models
Athena, Redshift, EMR, OpenSearch SQL on S3; warehouse; Hadoop and Spark; search and logs
Kinesis, Firehose, Glue Streams; delivery; prepare and catalog
Exam tip

Pre-built AI services do one task; SageMaker AI is for your own models.

Look-Alikes: Billing, Pricing and Support

Look-alikes Tell them apart
Savings Plans, Reserved Instances Commit to hourly spend; commit to a configuration
Spot, Dedicated Hosts, Capacity Reservations Interruptible; your licenses; guaranteed capacity
Pricing Calculator, Cost Explorer, Budgets Estimate; analyze; warn
Tags, Cost and Usage Reports Label costs; detailed data
Compute Optimizer, Trusted Advisor Rightsizing; checks and recommendations
Basic, Business Support+, Enterprise, Unified Operations Everyone; production; a TAM; fastest response
Health Dashboard, Trusted Advisor AWS problems that affect you; checks on your account
Professional Services, Partners, Marketplace AWS consulting; the ecosystem; software to buy
Exam tip

Cost questions hide in plain sight: look for the words estimate, analyze, warn and commit.

Service Chooser: Security, Identity and Governance

I need to… Use
Give an application temporary access An IAM role
Protect the root user MFA, no access keys, no daily use
Find AWS's compliance reports AWS Artifact
Record who changed a setting AWS CloudTrail
Block SQL injection at a load balancer AWS WAF
Detect stolen credentials Amazon GuardDuty
Scan servers for vulnerabilities Amazon Inspector
Encrypt data and manage the keys AWS KMS
Set up many accounts with guardrails AWS Control Tower
Exam tip

Name the verb in the need: record, block, detect, scan, encrypt.

Service Chooser: Compute, Storage, Databases and Networking

I need to… Use
Run a server I control Amazon EC2
Add and remove servers with demand EC2 Auto Scaling
Run containers with no servers, or code on an event Fargate, or Lambda
Archive for years at the lowest cost S3 Glacier Deep Archive
Share files between Linux servers Amazon EFS
A managed relational database Amazon RDS
Millisecond key lookups at any scale Amazon DynamoDB
Deliver content faster worldwide Amazon CloudFront
A dedicated line to my data center AWS Direct Connect
Exam tip

Match the data model and the management you want to the service.

Service Chooser: AI, Analytics, Integration, Cost and Support

I need to… Use
Find the sentiment of reviews Amazon Comprehend
Pull text out of scanned invoices Amazon Textract
Run SQL on files in S3 Amazon Athena
Send one message to many receivers Amazon SNS
Estimate a cost before building AWS Pricing Calculator
Warn me before spending passes a limit AWS Budgets
Save on steady usage, or on interruptible work Savings Plans, or Spot
Get 24/7 cloud engineers for production Business Support+
Buy third-party software AWS Marketplace
Exam tip

If two answers fit, choose the one that needs less setup or grants less access.

Lists the Exam Likes

  • Six advantages: variable expense, economies of scale, no capacity guessing, speed and agility, no data center upkeep, global reach
  • Six pillars: operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, sustainability
  • Seven Rs: retire, retain, rehost, relocate, replatform, repurchase, refactor
  • S3 classes: Standard, Intelligent-Tiering, Standard-IA, One Zone-IA, Glacier Instant, Flexible, Deep Archive
  • EC2 options: On-Demand, Savings Plans, Reserved, Spot, Dedicated Hosts, Dedicated Instances, Capacity Reservations
  • Support plans: Basic, Business Support+, Enterprise Support, Unified Operations
Exam tip

Lists are easy points: say each one aloud from memory.

Terms That Trip People Up

Term Meaning
Region, Availability Zone, edge location A group of zones; data centers with separate power; a cache near users
Elasticity, high availability Capacity follows demand; the workload survives failure
Least privilege Only the permissions a task needs
Stateful, stateless Replies allowed automatically; replies need their own rule
Serverless No servers to provision or manage
Decouple Connect parts through a queue or events
Tiered pricing The price per unit falls as volume rises
Consolidated billing One bill, shared discounts, many accounts
Exam tip

When two terms look alike, say the one-line difference before you answer.

3Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
One page four domains, 65 questions, 90 minutes, 700 to pass
Look-alikes learn the one-line job of each service; the exam describes the job
Chooser name the verb in the need, then the service
Lists six advantages, six pillars, seven Rs, S3 classes, EC2 options, support plans
Terms Region, zone, edge, elasticity, stateful, serverless, decouple, tiered pricing
